title: 第九十三章血气契约第九十二章轮到我聊正事了吧
content_zh:
第九十三章，血气契约！
“哈哈哈！”
“老夫太过开心，差点忘了，小友似乎也有事相求。”
“说吧，让老夫听听，你想要什么。”
冯老笑着道。
而秦风却神情十分凝重道：“前辈，敢问四方商会里，有没有龙血？”
原本还笑嘻嘻的冯老听到秦风的话后，顿时表情僵硬，目瞪口呆。
秦风见状，心中一沉，不由喃喃道：“难道连四方商会也没有龙血么？”
“要真是如此，那就麻烦了啊。”
“诶！！”
“龙血？”
“小子，你是指真正的龙血？还是指？？”
冯老回过神来，不由反问。
“当然是真正的龙血，品阶无所谓，只要是龙血就行。”
“晚辈知道，龙这种生物，十分强大，但以四方商会的能力，肯定能够弄到吧？？”
秦风回应道。
“等一下，小子。”
“你要龙血作甚？”
“莫非是用来修炼龙家老祖的传承手段？”
冯老转移话题道。

秦风闻言，没有遮掩，而是点头道：“没错，晚辈的确需要龙血来提升招式之威。”
“明白了。”
“不过，你的要求，老夫也是闻所未闻。”
“龙血这东西，太过稀奇，即便是我都没有见过。”
“至于商会里有没有，恐怕得需要老夫问问才行。”
“可能会有，也可能没有。”
“毕竟，龙血可是世间罕物，只有炼天境的强者，才有资格和龙一战。”
冯老无奈说道。
“好吧，晚辈明白了。”
“恳求前辈多多留意，若是商会里有龙血，我愿付出任何代价得到。”
秦风十分认真道。
“好！”
“老夫立马将消息传回去，等待两日便会有答案。”
“不过，我没记错的话，龙家应该有龙血存在的吧？”
冯老话锋一转道。
秦风蹙眉道：“是么？那我就不知道了。”
“如果龙家有龙血，倒是好事情。”
content_en:
Chapter 93, Blood Contract!
"Hahaha!"
"I was so happy that I almost forgot that my little friend seems to have something to ask for."
"Tell me, let me hear what you want."
Mr. Feng said with a smile.
But Qin Feng said with a very solemn expression: "Senior, may I ask if there is dragon blood in the Sifang Chamber of Commerce?"
After hearing what Qin Feng said, Mr. Feng, who was still smiling at first, suddenly stiffened and was stunned.
When Qin Feng saw this, his heart sank, and he couldn't help but murmured: "Doesn't even the Sifang Chamber of Commerce have dragon blood?"
"If that's really the case, that would be troublesome."
"Hey!!"
"Dragon blood?"
"Boy, do you mean real dragon blood? Or??"
Mr. Feng came back to his senses and couldn't help but ask.
"Of course it's real dragon blood. The grade doesn't matter, as long as it's dragon blood."
"Junior knows that creatures like dragons are very powerful, but with the ability of the Sifang Chamber of Commerce, they can definitely get it, right??"
Qin Feng responded.
"Wait a minute, kid."
"What do you want dragon blood for?"
"Could it be the inheritance method used to practice the ancestors of the Long family?"
Mr. Feng changed the topic.
When Qin Feng heard this, he did not hide it, but nodded and said: "Yes, this junior does need dragon blood to enhance the power of his moves."
"Got it."
"However, I have never heard of your request."
"Dragon blood is so rare, even I have never seen it."
"As for whether there are any in the Chamber of Commerce, I'm afraid I have to ask."
"Maybe there is, maybe there isn't."
"After all, dragon blood is a rare thing in the world. Only strong men in the Heaven Refining Realm are qualified to fight a dragon."
Mr. Feng said helplessly.
"Okay, junior understands."
"I beg you, senior, to pay more attention. If there is dragon blood in the Chamber of Commerce, I am willing to pay any price to get it."
Qin Feng said very seriously.
"Okay!"
"I will send the news back immediately, and I will have an answer in two days."
"However, if I remember correctly, there should be dragon blood in the Long family, right?"
Old Feng changed the subject.
Qin Feng frowned and said, "Really? Then I don't know."
"It would be a good thing if the Long family has dragon blood."
